purpose: Coordinate-gated canonical geography exact-bind input for Grok deterministic seal; not production geography by itself.

governance.exactness: Only T1/T2 exact named physical features are coordinate-ready; all others remain null.
governance.id_policy: Reuse only exact existing IDs. Proposed IDs are research labels, not authorization to mint them.
governance.corridor_policy: Corridors are global geography and may not be authored per partner. Grok must bind routes to canonical clusters and partner views inherit global_canonical ∩ partner.clusters.
governance.geometry_policy: Grok must generate/validate water-aware geometry, range, land crossing, endpoint accessibility, and dedupe. Straight-line research geometry is prohibited.
governance.economics_policy: No economics, access, navigability, service-frequency, or passenger-demand claim is authorized by coordinate readiness.
governance.silent_drop_policy: Every candidate must be sealed or appear in a reasoned drop/hold ledger; 0 silent drops.
